aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretch growth. It leans into leveraged ETFs and high-scoring setups, which significantly raises both upside and drawdown potential. Be aware of daily decay and rebalancing effects on leveraged ETFs, and the potential for rapid losses if stops are not strictly adhered to.
